title: Sections and stalks of the sharpened affine monoid structure sheaf
statement:
Let $P$ be a fine commutative monoid, written additively, let $X=\operatorname{Spec}_{\mathrm{mon}}P$, and let $\overline{\mathcal M}_P$ be the sheafification of the quotient of its monoid structure sheaf by units [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup]. For $a\in P$, write $P_a=P-\mathbf N a\subset P^{\mathrm{gp}}$. For a prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset P$, put $F=P\setminus\mathfrak p$ and $P_{\mathfrak p}=P-F\subset P^{\mathrm{gp}}$. There are canonical identifications
$$\Gamma(D(a),\overline{\mathcal M}_P)=P_a/P_a^\times,\qquad (\overline{\mathcal M}_P)_{\mathfrak p}=P_{\mathfrak p}/P_{\mathfrak p}^\times.$$
The restriction and germ homomorphisms in these identifications are induced by localization, and the canonical section of $p\in P$ has zero germ at $\mathfrak p$ if and only if $p\notin\mathfrak p$.

source.place: Expose VIII, 3.1.3 and Remark 3.1.4(i),(iii), printed pp.98--99; localization and sharpening in 3.1.1--3.1.2.

proof.text: For a commutative-monoid presheaf M on the open site, consider a nonempty open U with a point m whose every open neighborhood contains U. Mathlib's forgetful PreservesSheafification instance sends the sheafification unit to a set-valued local equivalence. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-large-set-sheafification] to this map to obtain local injectivity and surjectivity. Evaluate the covering equalizer sieve or image sieve at m. A covering arrow V -> U whose domain contains m has U <= V, hence V = U; its restriction is the identity. This proves that the actual unit component at U is bijective. This argument applies both to the local-fraction presheaf and to its sectionwise quotient by units from [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup].

source.place: Expose VIII, 3.1.3 and Remark 3.1.4(i),(iii), printed pp.98--99; localization and sharpening in 3.1.1--3.1.2.

proof.text: For a in P, choose the greatest prime m of D(a) from [lem-trf-monoid-principal-open-face]. The localization at the complement of m equals P_a: its denominators are in the principal face F_a, so D(a) is contained in each denominator basic open, and the same lemma includes that denominator localization in P_a. Conversely powers of a lie in the prime complement. A compatible local-fraction section on D(a), as defined in [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup], is constant and can be evaluated at m. Its inverse sends q in P_a to the constant family with ambient value q, which lies in every point localization since a avoids every prime of D(a). These maps are inverse monoid homomorphisms.

source.place: Expose VIII, 3.1.3 and Remark 3.1.4(i),(iii), printed pp.98--99; localization and sharpening in 3.1.1--3.1.2.

proof.text: Apply Step 1 to both sheafification units on D(a). Transport the equivalence of Step 2 through the first unit, then through Associates, and then through the second unit. Invert the resulting multiplicative equivalence to obtain sections(a). The two units compose to a natural transformation from the sharpening of the raw local-fraction presheaf to the affine sharp presheaf. Its naturality proves the canonical numerator equation. For D(b) contained in D(a), use the localization inclusion from [lem-trf-monoid-principal-open-face]; a constant fraction family restricts to the constant family with the same ambient value. Naturality of the composite unit gives the required restriction formula.

source.place: Expose VIII, 3.1.3 and Remark 3.1.4(i),(iii), printed pp.98--99; localization and sharpening in 3.1.1--3.1.2.

proof.text: Reindex a finite generating set of P by Fin(r). For each prime x, [lem-trf-monoid-prime-minimal-neighborhood] gives a product b of generators avoiding x, the smallest neighborhood D(b), and the equality of P_b with localization at the full complement of x. The object D(b) is terminal in the opposite neighborhood category. By Mathlib's IsColimit.isIso_ι_app_of_isTerminal the actual germ map from D(b) to the stalk defined in [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup] is an isomorphism. Invert it, compose with sections(b), and transport along the equality of localization submonoids to define stalks(x). The colimit relation identifies a germ from any D(a) containing x with restriction to D(b); Step 3 then proves the requested germ formula.

source.place: Expose VIII, 3.1.3 and Remark 3.1.4(i),(iii), printed pp.98--99; localization and sharpening in 3.1.1--3.1.2.

proof.text: Apply the numerator formula on D(1) and the germ formula at x. Naturality of germs identifies the resulting element with affineGerm(x,p), and its representing localized element has ambient value of(p). A class in Associates equals 1 precisely when its representative is a unit. In a commutative monoid this means that there is a localized v with of(p)*v = 1. The final units criterion of [lem-trf-monoid-prime-minimal-neighborhood] makes this equivalent to p not belonging to x. No additional finiteness, saturation, sharpness or torsion assumption is used.

source.place: Expose VIII, 3.1.3 and Remark 3.1.4(i),(iii), printed pp.98--99; localization and sharpening in 3.1.1--3.1.2.

lean.statement: theorem affineFan_localization_sections (P : Type u) [CommMonoid P] (hP : IsFine P) : ∃ (sections : ∀ a : P, (affine P).presheaf.obj (op (basicOpen a)) ≃* Associates (Algebra.faceLocalization P (Submonoid.powers a))) (stalks : ∀ x : MonoidPrime P, stalk (affine P).presheaf x ≃* Associates (Algebra.faceLocalization P (Submonoid.closure {a : P | a ∉ x.carrier}))), (∀ a p : P, ∃ q : Algebra.faceLocalization P (Submonoid.powers a), q.val = Algebra.GrothendieckGroup.of p ∧ sections a ((affine P).presheaf.map (homOfLE le_top).op (affineSection P p)) = Associates.mk q) ∧ (∀ (a b : P) (h : basicOpen b ≤ basicOpen a) (q : Algebra.faceLocalization P (Submonoid.powers a)), ∃ r : Algebra.faceLocalization P (Submonoid.powers b), r.val = q.val ∧ sections b ((affine P).presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op ((sections a).symm (Associates.mk q))) = Associates.mk r) ∧ (∀ (a : P) (x : MonoidPrime P) (hx : x ∈ basicOpen a) (q : Algebra.faceLocalization P (Submonoid.powers a)), ∃ r : Algebra.faceLocalization P (Submonoid.closure {p : P | p ∉ x.carrier}), r.val = q.val ∧ stalks x (germ (affine P).presheaf (basicOpen a) x hx ((sections a).symm (Associates.mk q))) = Associates.mk r) ∧ (∀ (x : MonoidPrime P) (p : P), affineGerm x p = 1 ↔ p ∉ x.carrier)
